description: Use this when the user wants word counts or a word frequency table for a text, for example "which words come up most in these reviews" or "count word frequency". Takes text up to 100,000 characters, a stop-word language (en, es, fr, de, it, pt or none), extra words to leave out, a case rule, a minimum word length and whether to count numbers. Returns totals, what was skipped and why, the top words with counts and percents, and a CSV of all counted words. Uses the same word rules as make_word_cloud. Does not draw a picture, read files, stem words or split Chinese, Japanese or Thai text into words.

case.description: fold (default for text): Apple and apple count as one word, shown in lower case; as_written (default for a word list): case is kept and counted apart.

exclude_words.description: Extra words to leave out, up to 100, matched without case, e.g. ["project", "team"].

include_numbers.description: Count number-only words such as 2026 (default false).

min_length.description: Shortest word to count, in characters, 1 to 20 (default 2), e.g. 3.

stop_words.description: Stop-word list to remove common function words: en (default, English), es, fr, de, it, pt, or none to keep all words. Other languages keep all words, e.g. "es".

text.description: The text to count, up to 100,000 characters, e.g. an article, survey answers or meeting notes pasted by the user.

name: count_words
title: Count words
